title: feat(mix3sel): no 1-bit or 2-bit Q equals mixed3 cov8-equality
science: Runner check thm1-fifteen-q8-true-pairs asserts and verifies an exact equivalence never stated as a theorem in the note: cov8=0 on both Q8-false maps and cov8>0 on all 30 Q8-true maps, i.e. cov8>0 iff Q8 on all 32 F_cut maps. Also reports the unique equal-cov8 pair (0,1,0,0,*) at cov8=1 and the f_L1 prefix split cov8=494 vs 446.
